import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = Path('/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-251-20261014')
STAGE = Path('/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-251-preflight-20261014/authority-staging')
OUT = Path('/private/tmp/pathwaymech-next-251-integration-review')
BASE = 'cd42a526b06ce531e8326a2717d54d7ff770bd2b'
def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024*1024), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()
def gitbytes(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{BASE}:{path}'], cwd=ROOT)
commands=json.loads((STAGE/'canonical-build-commands.json').read_text())
def run(kind):
    cmd=commands[kind+'_builder'][:]
    path=OUT/(kind+'.replayed.json')
    cmd[cmd.index('--output')+1]=str(path)
    start=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    env={**os.environ,'PYTHONPATH':str(ROOT/'src'),'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
    result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ROOT,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
    log=OUT/(kind+'-replay.log')
    log.write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr)
    expected=STAGE/('sources.union.json' if kind=='source' else 'ontology.union.json')
    receipt={'command':cmd,'cwd':str(ROOT),'started_utc':start,'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'exit_code':result.returncode,'log_sha256':digest(log),'original_output_sha256':digest(expected)}
    if path.exists():
        receipt.update(output_sha256=digest(path),byte_identical=path.read_bytes()==expected.read_bytes())
    (OUT/(kind+'-replay-receipt.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
    assert result.returncode == 0, receipt
    assert receipt['byte_identical'], receipt
    return receipt
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    results=list(pool.map(run,['source','ontology']))
summary={'base':BASE,'reviewer':'next251_integration_review','replays':results,'preservation':{}}
for kind,name in [('source','sources'),('ontology','ontology')]:
    old=json.loads(gitbytes('data/identifier_authorities/'+name+'.json'))
    new=json.loads((OUT/(kind+'.replayed.json')).read_text())
    for field in ('terms','sources'):
        missing={k:v for k,v in old[field].items() if k not in new[field]}
        changed={k:[v,new[field].get(k)] for k,v in old[field].items() if k in new[field] and v!=new[field][k]}
        summary['preservation'][name+'_'+field]={'old':len(old[field]),'new':len(new[field]),'missing':missing,'changed':changed,'added':sorted(set(new[field])-set(old[field]))}
        assert not missing and not changed
old_manifest=json.loads(gitbytes('conf/identifier_sources.json'))
new_manifest=json.loads((STAGE/'identifier_sources.json').read_text())
assert old_manifest==new_manifest[:len(old_manifest)]
summary['manifest']={'old_count':len(old_manifest),'new_count':len(new_manifest),'old_ordered_prefix_identical':True}
new_sources=[]
for entry in new_manifest[len(old_manifest):]:
    path=STAGE/'originals'/entry['path']
    actual=digest(path)
    assert actual==entry['sha256']
    new_sources.append({'key':entry['key'],'path':str(path.resolve()),'sha256':actual,'bytes':path.stat().st_size})
summary['new_original_hashes']=new_sources
record_paths=[p for p in subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',BASE,'data/pathways'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).splitlines() if p.endswith('.yaml')]
summary['baseline_records']={'count':len(record_paths),'changed':[p for p in record_paths if gitbytes(p)!=(ROOT/p).read_bytes()]}
assert not summary['baseline_records']['changed']
(OUT/'authority-independent-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'pass':True,'old_records':len(record_paths),'manifest_entries':len(new_manifest),'new_originals':len(new_sources),'source_terms':summary['preservation']['sources_terms']['new'],'ontology_terms':summary['preservation']['ontology_terms']['new']}))
